name: get_candidates
description: The candidate pool: up to 150 titles TMDB suggests for this taste profile, best first (pre-ranked by overlap with the profile). Anything watched, started, dropped, hidden or turned down is already left out; library titles stay (in_library). Every filter is optional (null). Each item: media_type, tmdb_id, title, date, genres, lang, anime, runtime (minutes; a show's per episode), seasons, ended, vote (TMDB), why (its sources: rec:<loved title> and similar:<loved title> are TMDB's picks for a title they loved; kw their keywords; new, gems and lang discover; trending, upcoming, on_air), in_library, watchlist.

media_type.description: movie or tv; null for both.

genres.description: Any of these genres, by name as the profile and candidates name them (Drama, Science Fiction, Animation); null for any.

min_runtime.description: At least this many minutes: a movie's runtime, a show's episode runtime. Titles with no known runtime are left out.

max_runtime.description: At most this many minutes, as min_runtime.

year_from.description: Released (or first aired) in this year or later.

year_to.description: Released (or first aired) in this year or earlier.

language.description: Original language, ISO 639-1 (en, ja, ko); null for any.

anime.description: true: anime only; false: no anime; null: either.

limit.description: At most this many, 1–60; null for 30.
